description: Quickstart for viaSocket: use the user's own apps from their AI (send an email, post to Slack, add a sheet row, read a CRM; any of 2,300+ apps), build automations (flows) across those apps, and for developers: build and manage viaSocket plugins in the Developer Hub, set up a product's viaSocket keys, give a product its own MCP server. Routes plug work through the plug skills index, product integration through the viaSocket skill, and Embarko deploy through Embarko's quickstart. Load this before any viaSocket task. Call this to load the full instructions for this skill before doing the task.
name: quickstart-viasocket-developer-hub
